generated_for: Installed-path, XDG, migration, and destructive-lifecycle investigation
note: Every entry is anchored to an exact source substring that must occur exactly once. validate_evidence.py re-checks the anchors, so an H4 change to a consumer breaks this inventory rather than leaving it silently describing code that no longer exists.

consumers.name: Profile registry
consumers.current: NOTRIOS_PROFILE_REGISTRY, else <config>/profiles.json from internal/paths; refuses rather than inventing a path when no config root can be resolved

consumers.name: Generated runtime profile configs
consumers.current: <dir of registry>/profiles/<profile_id>.yaml; the registry now lands in the config root by construction

consumers.name: Sync key material
consumers.current: <config>/sync-keys[-<database_id>].json, from the same resolver as the profile registry

consumers.name: Service configuration file
consumers.current: --config when given, else <config>/config.yaml, else the checkout's config/config.example.yaml in source mode only, else compiled defaults
consumers.target: --config, else <config>/config.yaml, else compiled defaults; the checkout example is read only in source mode

consumers.name: Data directory root
consumers.anchor: {"data.directory", paths.RootData, nil, func(c *Config, v string) { c.Data.Directory = v }},
consumers.current: <data> when the configuration does not state it; a stated path is never relocated

consumers.name: SQLite database
consumers.anchor: {"data.database_path", paths.RootData, []string{"notes.sqlite"}, func(c *Config, v string) { c.Data.DatabasePath = v }},
consumers.current: <data>/notes.sqlite when unstated

consumers.name: Asset store
consumers.anchor: {"data.asset_store", paths.RootData, []string{"assets"}, func(c *Config, v string) { c.Data.AssetStore = v }},
consumers.current: <data>/assets when unstated

consumers.name: Asset store derived from a database path
consumers.current: <parent of database>/assets using filepath.Dir, so a Windows path no longer yields the working directory

consumers.name: Asset store for :memory: databases
consumers.current: a private per-process directory from os.MkdirTemp, not one fixed name shared by every user and instance
consumers.target: a per-process directory created with os.MkdirTemp under <runtime>, removed on close

consumers.name: Publication profiles
consumers.current: NOTRIOS_PUBLISH_PROFILES, else <data directory>/publish-profiles.json; the data directory is now resolved rather than defaulting to the working directory
consumers.target: <data>/publish-profiles.json; refuse rather than fall back to the working directory

consumers.name: Sync carrier spool
consumers.current: <state>/sync-carrier, falling back to the data directory

consumers.name: Sync backup store
consumers.current: <state>/sync-backups, falling back to the data directory

consumers.name: REST catch-up inbox
consumers.current: <state>/catchup-inbox/<backup id>

consumers.name: Remote-media quarantine
consumers.anchor: {"remote_media.quarantine_dir", paths.RootState, []string{"quarantine"}, func(c *Config, v string) { c.RemoteMedia.QuarantineDir = v }},
consumers.current: <state>/quarantine when unstated; state rather than cache because it records what a note tried to fetch

consumers.name: Projection export directory
consumers.anchor: {"data.projection_dir", paths.RootCache, []string{"projections"}, func(c *Config, v string) { c.Data.ProjectionDir = v }},
consumers.current: <cache>/projections when unstated

consumers.name: Recoll search index
consumers.anchor: {"search_sidecar.index_dir", paths.RootCache, []string{"search-index"}, func(c *Config, v string) { c.SearchSidecar.IndexDir = v }},
consumers.current: <cache>/search-index when unstated

consumers.name: Generated Recoll configuration directory
consumers.current: a caller-supplied directory under <cache>, created 0700; fully regenerated

consumers.name: Remote media fetch directory
consumers.current: under <state>/quarantine, created 0700

consumers.name: Portable backup staging
consumers.current: <runtime>/backup-staging, falling back to state then data
consumers.target: <runtime>/backup-staging; falls back to <state> when no runtime root exists

consumers.name: Restore review staging
consumers.current: <runtime>/restore-review, falling back to state then data
consumers.target: <runtime>/restore-review; falls back to <state> when no runtime root exists

consumers.name: ABI database owner lock
consumers.current: a lock file beside the database, keyed by the symlink-resolved canonical database path
consumers.target: unchanged: the lock must sit beside the resource it guards so a second process on the same database finds it

consumers.name: Built web interface
consumers.current: --web-dir when set, else web/dist relative to the working directory, then <exe dir>/web/dist, then <exe parent>/web/dist
consumers.target: --web-dir, else <datadir>/notrios/web, else executable-relative; the working directory only in source mode

consumers.name: Help notebook seed source
consumers.current: the first positional argument, else the literal "docs" relative to the current working directory
consumers.target: <program_assets>/docs; the working-directory default only in source mode

consumers.name: notrios:// URL handler desktop entry
consumers.current: --dir, else $HOME/.local/share/applications/notrios-url-handler.desktop, plus update-desktop-database and xdg-mime

consumers.name: Physical snapshot image output root
consumers.current: fully caller-supplied; no default. Refuses a path overlapping the asset store, a symlink, a non-directory, and an existing complete snapshot; creates 0700
consumers.target: unchanged: the user names the destination, which is the point of a portable snapshot
